Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Alain Royer <cro...@dagon.megatoon.com> writes:
>When a Vampire goes to torpor, did the Haven Undercover is
>burn?

No. It remains with the vampire. It is dormant (unusable for
the purpose of initiating combat) until the torpored target
leaves torpor, at which time the vampire will again
be available for fist parties at +1 stealth :-) .
